items.title: TwoSpeedStrategist sends event-driven and replan requests to the fast (Refine) strategist when the event arrived while a request was in flight
items.evidence: Commit 15d15fb, src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot/Strategy/TwoSpeedStrategist.cs. Each request is now settled against the next context's ActiveIntent. The fast strategist is used only while the active intent is the slow strategist's own choice or a refinement of it. A slow turn counts only when its answer was applied, or was delivered while that commitment stood. Test StrategyLifecycleTests.Two_speed_sends_the_request_an_event_deferred_to_the_slow_strategist uses the real scheduler, validator and arbiter: the event arrives at t=2, the slow answer is late-discarded at t=3, and the deferred request must go to slow. Before the fix it failed with 'Expected: 2 Actual: 1' slow calls; after the fix it passes. One case remains: the slow strategist's own intent is active, an event late-discards its newer answer, and the deferred request has no event in its features. This class cannot tell that from an arbiter refusal, and replan:* reasons are not visible to it either. That case needs the trigger in StrategistContext (see cross_area).

items.title: Decision-log content, and the LLM prompt, depend on the process culture, so hashes differ between machines and locales
items.evidence: Commit 976521e ('format decision rationales and reasons in the invariant culture'). ContextualBanditStrategist.cs:63 and :91, DistilledStrategist, PinnedPlaybookStrategist, PlaybookSelector and StrategyRationale.Explain all use string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ...). FeatureCompiler.Events and the planner notes were changed in the same commit. The Arena and Tune csproj set InvariantGlobalization=true. Test RationaleTests.Rationales_do_not_depend_on_the_machine_locale compares every strategist's rationale under de-DE and the invariant culture. Outside this area, IntentValidator.cs lines 56, 63, 78, 166, 169 and 203 still interpolate doubles in the current culture (see cross_area).

items.title: Arena datasets carry no observation mode, so oracle-run decisions can silently train a Belief-mode distilled arm
items.evidence: Commit 4fb57d2. DecisionExample now has an ObservationMode Mode field (defaults to Belief for legacy lines). FromDecisionLog reads an optional 'mode' payload field, or falls back to a new mode parameter; a malformed mode is skipped. DecisionDataset.HasOracleExamples is added. DistilledOptions.Mode defaults to Belief, and DistilledStrategist then leaves oracle examples out of training and reports the count in OracleExamplesIgnored. Test DecisionDatasetModeTests.A_belief_distilled_strategist_does_not_train_on_oracle_decisions failed before the fix ('Expected: 0 Actual: 20' TrainedOn) and passes after. The other new tests cover the mode fallback and the NDJSON round trip. It only works end to end once the arbiter writes 'mode' or the arena passes the mode (see cross_area).

items.title: TwoSpeedStrategist sends a fallback or emergency placeholder to the fast Refine model; its renewal promotes the placeholder to a primary commitment and the LLM's next choice is refused
items.evidence: Commit 15d15fb, same change as the first finding: a placeholder is never the slow strategist's own intent, so every request goes to slow until the slow choice is applied. Test StrategyLifecycleTests.Two_speed_never_lets_the_fast_strategist_renew_a_placeholder_after_a_failed_slow_request uses the real scheduler: the first slow call returns null, then the test asserts that no fast context holds an fb-* intent, that allied-boom ends up active, and that there were 2 slow calls. Before the fix it failed ('Assert.All() Failure: 1 out of 3 items', the fast strategist renewed fb-0); after the fix it passes. The control test Two_speed_keeps_the_fast_strategist_between_slow_turns_once_the_slow_choice_is_active checks that normal 20 s slow / 5 s fast routing is unchanged.

items.title: The bandit credits every proposal with the match reward, including the ones the arbiter refused and that never took effect
items.evidence: Commit 9ca667c, ContextualBanditStrategist.cs. A proposal is now held as pending and added to the episode only if the next request's ActiveIntent carries its intent id. CompleteEpisode(reward, finalActive = null) uses finalActive to settle the last proposal, and AbandonEpisode clears it. Test StrategyLifecycleTests.Bandit_learns_only_from_decisions_that_became_the_active_intent failed before the fix ('Expected: 1 Actual: 3') and passes after. A new test, Bandit_credits_the_last_decision_when_it_is_the_final_active_intent, covers the final proposal. StrategyTests.Bandit_learns_which_playbook_pays_in_a_context was updated to pass the active intent. Until the arena passes the final active intent (see cross_area), each match's last bandit proposal is dropped, not credited.

1) Contracts/Strategy.cs + Runtime/StrategyScheduler.cs: add a trigger reason (e.g. `string? Trigger = null`) to StrategistContext and pass the scheduler's `reason` ("event:*", "replan:*", "cadence", "initial") in Start/Context. In BotAgentFactory.cs, give an oracle distilled arm `new DistilledOptions(Mode: ObservationMode.Oracle)`, and in onFinish (about line 230) call `bandit.CompleteEpisode(Reward(...), <arbiter's final active intent>)` so the last applied bandit decision is credited.
4) Arbitration/IntentValidator.cs lines 56, 63, 78, 166, 169 and 203 still format doubles in the current culture. Wrap them in string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ...), or set InvariantGlobalization/CA1305 in Directory.Build.props for the bot library and test hosts.

items.evidence: 617c59b. A repeat upsert of a tracked id now refreshes position, health and owner without a second EntityCreated. bridge-ci.cross_area: Missing queues, credits and power (src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot, contract and planner owners): (1) In src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot/Contracts/Observation.cs ObservationFrame, make Queues nullable (IReadOnlyList<ProductionQueueState>? Queues, where null means the source does not report queues), or add a bool QueuesKnown. Make Credits and Power nullable, or add CreditsKnown and PowerKnown, so the bridge can say 'not yet sampled' instead of sending 0. (2) In the OperationalPlanner, when queues are unknown, HasRoom must not treat an absent queue as free. Suppress queue-driven ProduceCommand, or gate it on the planner's own issued-command ledger with a timeout, and do not charge the budget ledger per plan. (3) Once the contract changes, Ra2ObservationAssembler.BuildFrame (bridge-ci area) passes null or unknown for queues, and for credits and power before the first sample. Separately, callers constructing Ra2ObservationAssembler for team games or maps with neutral houses must now pass nonHostileOwners from the match plan (SpawnMatchPlan/SpawnIniRenderer know teams and the special house). No production caller outside tests exists yet. The native ra2yrcpp telemetry source (outside the repo) must re-send the created/placed upsert at least once per frame cadence for each enemy in sight, and for own units whose state changes. It must include visible (or killer) on enemy destroyed/killed payloads, as now documented in Ra2BotTelemetryContract.

Enemies = null` to ObservationFrame (null keeps today's behaviour, where every non-self owner is an enemy). Two sources then fill it. First, SkirmishSimulation.Observe sets it to every other player. operations-tactics.cross_area: 1) Contracts/Rules: UnitRule has no repair flag. RulesmdImporter.InferRole gives a retail service depot (UnitRepair=yes, has prerequisites) the Tech role, so with imported rules RepairController, which now selects Support-role buildings only, finds no depot and does nothing. That is safe but means no repair. Add `bool Repairs` to UnitRule (importer: UnitRepair=yes; fixture: GADEPT/NADEPT true) and let RepairController select depots by it; the Support-role rule is then no longer needed. 2) Sim (src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Sim/SkirmishSimulation.cs): ApplyRepair/AdvanceRepair heal anywhere without a depot, which inflates arena results; make healing require the unit to be within a few cells of an own Support/Repairs building. ApplyPlace has no footprint or overlap check; reject cells within BuildGridStep (or the footprint) of an existing building so the arena exercises the new placement retry. ApplyAttack pursues a target through fog; reject an AttackCommand on a target the attacker's side cannot see. 3) Expansion beyond placement range: no MCV is produced or escorted to a distant Expand region. Implementing that needs production plus a deploy flow (Operations and DeployController) and is not in these commits. 4) tools/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Baseline holds a frozen copy of the old planner and controllers; it was deliberately not changed.

sim-arena.cross_area: 1) SquadController (src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot, Tactics) still sends AttackCommand for contacts up to MaxContactAgeSeconds (20 s) old. Since fd95829 the sim rejects attacks on targets that are not visible, so those resends now count as InvalidCommands. The controller should attack only contacts visible in the current frame and attack-move to the last-seen cell otherwise. The RA2 bridge path would need the same rule. 2) docs/architecture/strategic-bot.md and strategic-bot-results.md should be updated for: the new map shapes (twin-valley has 9 regions with ore-east; open-steppe has 13 regions, mirrored); the arena strategy-table semantics (primary-only figures plus fallback, shadow-invalid and shadow-lateness columns, failed-request cost share); the leakage table's fog-violation-frames column; per-queue factory speed; offline powered defenses; harvester routing; and asset value that includes queued production and values a yard at its MCV's cost. Earlier arena results in the results doc came from the old sim and metrics and would need a rerun (only --llm-fake is possible without a credential). 3) Optional contract change: UnitRule has no factory-for-queue field, so the sim derives each queue's factories from prerequisites. The Aircraft and Naval queues have no Production-role factory in the fixture and fall back to all production buildings; an explicit Factory field, or GAAIRC/NARADR with Role=Production, would make this exact. 4) The suggested shadow-inclusive DatasetFilter for distilling shadow decisions (Strategy/Datasets in src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot) was not added.
